# REA_Skill (Reverse Engineer Anything + claude-red Unified 100-Skill Suite)

> REA_Skill: 100 agent skills across 25 categories + 500 prompts for Reverse Engineer Anything (REA) and comprehensive security auditing. Recover lost source code, decompile binaries, and audit web, mobile, cloud, wireless, API, and native software with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Antigravity.

- Website: https://smartworldarafath.github.io/REA_Skill/
- Repository: https://github.com/smartworldarafath/REA_Skill
- Manifest: https://github.com/smartworldarafath/REA_Skill/blob/main/claude-skills.json
- Mindmap: https://github.com/smartworldarafath/REA_Skill/blob/main/MINDMAP.md
- Install (Claude Code): /plugin marketplace add smartworldarafath/REA_Skill
- Install (any agent): npx skills add smartworldarafath/REA_Skill
- Install (script): ./install.sh --target ~/.claude/skills
- License: MIT

## Categories (25 Categories · 100 Skills)
- `rea-core` (12 skills): Binary disassembly, full A–Z lost source code recovery, APK/IPA, web bundles, protocols, databases, game assets, crash triage, firmware, and interactive grilling.
- `agent-ecosystem` (9 skills): Owner authorization, 10-layer website audit, ECC TDD rigor, Agent Reach, SurfSense RAG, Playwright, Bright Data, and Hyperbrowser MCPs.
- `web` (16 skills), `wireless` (14 skills), `infrastructure` (7 skills), `exploit-dev` (6 skills), `fuzzing` (4 skills), `post-exploitation` (3 skills), `active-directory` (2 skills), `auth` (2 skills), `recon` (2 skills), `api` (2 skills), `container` (2 skills), `cicd` (2 skills), `crypto` (2 skills), `privesc` (2 skills), `forensics` (2 skills), `supply-chain` (2 skills), `social-engineering` (2 skills), `utility` (2 skills), `cloud` (1 skill), `mobile` (1 skill), `iot` (1 skill), `network` (1 skill), `ai` (1 skill).
